extra.final_summary:
Found and fixed several data quality issues:
1. Dropped 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 7 and 11)
2. Normalized island labels - merged " Biscoe" and "Biscoe " into "Biscoe" (3 cells)
3. Converted body_mass_g from text to numeric (handled comma-formatted numbers)
4. Excluded 4 rows with out-of-range values: rows 1, 4, 12 had body_mass_g values (3800000, 3150000, 3700000) far outside the valid range [2500, 6500]; row 21 had flipper_length_mm = -187 outside [170, 235]

After cleaning, analyzed 16 Adelie penguin records. Average bill length by island:
- Biscoe: 39.025 mm
- Dream: 37.6667 mm
- Torgersen: 39.2667 mm
